description: This Scala source file defines the PodTemplateConfigMapStep class, which manages Kubernetes ConfigMaps for pod templates in Spark's Kubernetes deployment, including configuring pods and generating necessary Kubernetes resources.

classes.name: PodTemplateConfigMapStep
classes.description: Manages Kubernetes ConfigMaps for pod templates, configuring pods and generating Kubernetes resources based on template files.

methods.name: configurePod
methods.description: Configures a SparkPod with a ConfigMap volume and volume mount if a pod template is specified.

methods.name: getAdditionalPodSystemProperties
methods.description: Returns system properties related to the pod template file if present.

methods.name: getAdditionalKubernetesResources
methods.description: Generates Kubernetes ConfigMap resources from the specified pod template file.
